issue.title: Source SASE installs omit configured Telegram chop scripts, leaving chop doctor red
issue.description: PROPOSED BY: sase-um.9.1 note #1. Reproduced independently by sase-um.9.land on 2026-08-28 at sase HEAD fa74163b5 after the workspace's required just install. The source venv contains all SASE-owned chops but not sase_chop_tg_inbound or sase_chop_tg_outbound, while the effective host configuration enables both Telegram chops. The full doctor reports 35 configured chops and exits ERROR on exactly those two unresolved executables; ci_watch itself resolves and its dry-run works. Determine the correct ownership between project required-plugin declarations, tools/setup_required_plugins, and sase-telegram packaging. Make fresh source workspaces install or otherwise resolve configured integration chops without forcing unrelated optional plugins, and verify the full doctor is green when the host config enables Telegram.

task_type_fields.impact: Every source-workspace chop doctor remains red and masks the health of unrelated chops unless the operator manually installs sase-telegram into each ephemeral venv.
task_type_fields.location: tools/setup_required_plugins, project required-plugin inventory, and sase-telegram chop entry points
task_type_fields.repro: From a fresh numbered SASE workspace run just install, then .venv/bin/sase axe chop doctor. The doctor reports ERROR because configured scripts sase_chop_tg_inbound and sase_chop_tg_outbound cannot be resolved in that same venv.
